title: SCSegamba: Lightweight Structure-Aware Vision Mamba for Crack Segmentation in Structures
mechanism: Lightweight vision Mamba (2.8M params) with gated bottleneck convolution for crack morphology and a structure-aware scanning strategy for continuity between crack pixels.
adaptation: Must-have benchmark row. Train with official code on 512 px EL, 3-class (bg, crack, inactive) and 24-class versions; gray to 3 channels; needs mamba-ssm CUDA kernels (install needs the user's OK).
min_experiment: Arm: SCSegamba 3-class and 24-class; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive IoU. Kill as a model if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.02; keep as benchmark row.
evidence: R: F1 0.8390, mIoU 0.8479 on a multi-scenario dataset with 2.8M params; 104 citations. Tolerance in metrics unverified.
prior_overlap: none (no Mamba segmenter tried). Also listed in D12.

alt_notes.adaptation: Must-have benchmark entry. Official code, 1-channel stem, 512 px, crack + inactive + background and 24-class variants, house loss. Needs mamba-ssm CUDA kernels (install needs the user's OK).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SCSegamba official recipe on our folds; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, relF1@2, E1 relF1@2. Kill as a model if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.02; keep as benchmark row.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use a 24-class head, 1-channel input and 512 px, under the same 20k-step protocol and metrics as house. It needs a mamba-ssm CUDA build on cv02, which needs the user's OK.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark row: SCSegamba vs house, 3 seeds, full protocol (crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive, mIoU_rob, E1). As a score arm, kill if crack relF1@2 is below house.
